Weapon of Usefulness

Spell

1st level Transmutation (Ritual)
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Self
Components: V, S, M (a weapon)
Duration: 1 hour

Transform a weapon you are holding into an artisan tool of your choice. You treat the tool as proficient for the purposes of using it, though you do not add your proficiency bonus to rolls made with the tool.

Spell Lists: Artificer (Armswright)
